crossRefs.note: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor…

Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,
But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice…

who were born not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,
having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who…

Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,
translations.bsb: For it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer for Him,
translations.kjv: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
translations.asv: because to you it hath been granted in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer in his behalf:
